object.attr: derived: CF-V37 (D-V24). With MELLON-VER-SRS-266, an issue could go on older content than the issue before it; MELLON-VER-SRS-245 compares numbers only.
object.description: If the commit of the document's current issue is neither the commit for a new issue nor an ancestor of the commit, Mellon shall refuse the new issue.
